notes: As-shipped ettin-68m, hand-mapped onto 32 of 61 tags, 1,200 training documents: macro F1 0.2287 over the 31 tags present in gold. Real contextual signal on exactly the tags a hashed-ngram bag is weakest at - email 0.9464, zip_code 0.8946, phone_number 0.7895, family_name 0.7559, given_name 0.7420, street_number_and_name 0.7124 - with NO fine-tuning and truncation at 1024 tokens against a 12,000-character read window.

It contributes nothing yet on the identifiers the ship gate is about: SSN, MRN, ITIN, CVV and health-plan number all score 0.0000. Those tags are present in our training gold, so fine-tuning is the thing that would have to fix them; the pretrained signal does not already cover them.

No ceiling is available for the FUSED micro F1. The probe establishes that signal exists, not how much of it survives model2vec distillation to a static token table - which is the step with no evidence behind it at all and the reason the chain is staged.
